description: Defines an abstract class LocalStream implementing a Drupal stream wrapper for local files, providing methods for file operations, path resolution, and stream handling within Drupal's filesystem.

classes.name: LocalStream
classes.description: An abstract class implementing a stream wrapper interface for local filesystem operations in Drupal.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of stream wrapper, specifically StreamWrapperInterface::NORMAL.

methods.name: setUri
methods.description: Sets the URI for the stream.

methods.name: getUri
methods.description: Retrieves the current URI of the stream.

methods.name: getTarget
methods.description: Extracts the target path from a URI, removing scheme prefix.

methods.name: getLocalPath
methods.description: Returns the canonical local filesystem path for the current URI, handling virtual filesystem paths.

methods.name: stream_open
methods.description: Opens a stream for reading or writing based on the URI and mode.

methods.name: stream_lock
methods.description: Applies a lock to the stream handle.

methods.name: stream_read
methods.description: Reads data from the stream.

methods.name: stream_write
methods.description: Writes data to the stream.

methods.name: stream_eof
methods.description: Checks if end-of-file is reached.

methods.name: stream_seek
methods.description: Seeks to a position in the stream.

methods.name: stream_flush
methods.description: Flushes the stream.

methods.name: stream_tell
methods.description: Returns the current position in the stream.

methods.name: stream_stat
methods.description: Returns status information about the stream.

methods.name: stream_close
methods.description: Closes the stream handle.

methods.name: stream_cast
methods.description: Returns the handle for casting.

methods.name: stream_metadata
methods.description: Sets metadata (e.g., permissions, owner) on the file.

methods.name: stream_set_option
methods.description: Attempts to set stream options; not supported for local files.

methods.name: stream_truncate
methods.description: Truncates the stream to a specified size.

methods.name: unlink
methods.description: Deletes the file at the given URI.

methods.name: rename
methods.description: Renames a file from one URI to another.

methods.name: dirname
methods.description: Returns the directory part of a URI.

methods.name: mkdir
methods.description: Creates a directory at the specified URI.

methods.name: rmdir
methods.description: Removes a directory at the specified URI.

methods.name: url_stat
methods.description: Retrieves information about a file or directory.

methods.name: dir_opendir
methods.description: Opens a directory handle.

methods.name: dir_readdir
methods.description: Reads a directory entry.

methods.name: dir_rewinddir
methods.description: Rewinds the directory handle.

methods.name: dir_closedir
methods.description: Closes the directory handle.
